mapper.select: /* com.portal.system.code.zip.ZipManageMapper.selectZipDetail */ SELECT ZIP AS zip, SN AS sn, CTPRVN_NM AS ctprvnNm, SIGNGU_NM AS signguNm, EMD_NM AS emdNm, LI_BULD_NM AS liBuldNm, LNBR_DONG_HO AS lnbrDongHo FROM LETTCZIP WHERE ZIP = #{zip} AND SN = #{sn}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.system.code.zip.ZipManageMapper.insertExcelZip */ INSERT INTO LETTCZIP ( ZIP, SN, CTPRVN_NM, SIGNGU_NM, EMD_NM, LI_BULD_NM, LNBR_DONG_HO, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{zip}, #{sn}, #{ctprvnNm}, #{signguNm}, #{emdNm}, #{liBuldNm}, #{lnbrDongHo}, SYSDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE(), #{frstRegisterId} )
